item.title: US declares national emergency in 13 states to secure power grid; what it means
item.description: US government has declared a national emergency to address security risks posed by foreign-made electricity equipment. An executive order has been signed, allowing tighter restrictions on potentially dangerous foreign equipment. The new measures aim to protect the national grid from cyberattacks and supply disruptions. This initiative could also boost domestic manufacturers as reliance on potentially vulnerable foreign suppliers is reduced.

item.title: Texas man who couldn't afford Halloween costumes gives away 8,000 to families
item.description: Christophe Waggoner established a charity called October's Child to provide Halloween costumes for children. He began the initiative after recalling his own childhood experiences with costumes. Over the years, the charity has grown significantly, distributing nearly 8,000 costumes to families in need. In the upcoming event, he plans to give away over 4,000 costumes for various age groups. Waggoner's efforts illustrate the positive impact of community support on childhood celebrations.

item.title: California community completes $16.5m property purchase after 20-year search
item.description: After an extensive search, the West Valley Muslim Association has successfully acquired a property in Cupertino for $16.5 million. This new facility will serve as a permanent home for the community, offering a venue for daily prayers, educational activities, and community gatherings. Supported by a dedicated fundraising campaign, this purchase reflects the growing needs of the local Muslim population, establishing a vital center for faith and fellowship.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Celine Dion's former Florida mansion sells for $12.5m after $20m listing
item.description: Celine Dion’s former Florida mansion in Jupiter has sold for $12.5 million in an off-market deal. Built for the singer in 1998, the waterfront property was sold by her for $9 million in 2002. The 14,750-square-foot luxury home features eight bedrooms, a private dock, a swimming pool and a lavish home theatre. It was listed for $20 million earlier this year.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Michael Dell hails Trump Accounts as donor push grows
item.description: Michael Dell has endorsed the Trump Accounts initiative, which aims to provide American children with stock market investments. The program has opened approximately 9 million accounts for children under 18 and further plans to create accounts for all 70 million eligible kids. High-profile donors, including Gwynne Shotwell and Ray Dalio, are contributing funds to expand its reach.

item.title: Mississippi court backs father's deed giving family land to wife over children
item.description: A Mississippi father left his family home and 0.86 acres of land equally to his three children in a 2008 will but transferred the property to his wife in 2021. After his death, his daughter challenged the transfer, claiming he had been improperly influenced due to his declining health. On Tuesday, an appeals court rejected her challenge, finding insufficient evidence of undue influence.

item.title: Kelces’ Garage Beer sales surge 252% as $14M-barrel rival looms
item.description: Jason and Travis Kelce’s Garage Beer has emerged as a rising player in the US beer market, recording 252% sales growth in 2023 before the brothers invested in 2024. With 95 calories per serving and distribution across all 50 states, the brand is targeting mainstream light beer drinkers. Garage Beer expects to reach 300,000 barrels, but competing with established giants such as Michelob Ultra remains a significant challenge as it seeks long-term growth.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Andre Agassi’s $6.5M Las Vegas land sells for $18.15M in 2026
item.description: Andre Agassi sold his 1.8-acre homesite in Las Vegas’ exclusive Summit Club for $18.15 million, nearly tripling the $6.5 million he paid in 2018. The sale generated an $11.65 million gain before expenses. His brother, Phillip Agassi, said the tennis legend reconsidered building a large mansion as his children grow older. The buyer’s identity remains unknown, while the property’s location and luxury surroundings add to its appeal.

item.title: Sir Patrick Stewart dies at 86 after battle with Alzheimer’s and Lewy body dementia
item.description: Sir Patrick Stewart, the celebrated British actor known for Star Trek: The Next Generation and the X-Men franchise, has died at 86 at his Los Angeles home, according to a family statement. His death follows a battle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia. The acclaimed actor leaves behind a six-decade legacy across theatre, television and cinema.

item.title: 'Transgressions by China happen, it's not new': Arunachal CM says no intrusion along LAC
item.description: Pema Khandu asserted that border transgressions along the India-China frontier have been a longstanding issue, highlighting China's non-recognition of the McMahon Line. He described the recent confrontations as transgressions instead of intrusions and reassured citizens of the state's stability. Likewise, Union tourism minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat reaffirmed the safety of India's borders while working to alleviate media-induced tensions regarding the situation.

item.title: Devoleena Bhattacharjee defends women’s choice of keeping Karwa Chauth
item.description: Devoleena Bhattacharjee expressed her views on Karwa Chauth, a cherished festival where couples come together in India. She underscored the importance of personal choice in participating in such traditions. While she personally doesn't fast for the occasion, she respects its meaning for others. Devoleena believes that love should be celebrated uniquely, free from judgment. She extended heartfelt wishes for joy and deeper connections to all celebrating Karwa Chauth.

item.title: Harmanpreet, Sukhjeet score braces as India beat China 5-2 at Asian Champions Trophy
item.description: In a thrilling encounter at the Olympian Surjit Singh Hockey Stadium, Captain Harmanpreet Singh and forward Sukhjeet Singh starred for India, netting two goals each in the match against China. India took an early lead with Sukhjeet scoring at the 13th minute. Despite two goals from China, they failed to clinch the win. Next up for India is a crucial match against Japan in the tournament.

item.title: 'Don't push us': SC warns of harsh stand on firecrackers if orders go unenforced
item.description: The Supreme Court tackled the persistent air pollution crisis in Delhi-NCR, stressing the importance of adhering to current firecracker laws. Authorities were cautioned against inaction, as deteriorating air quality poses a threat to public health. The bench underlined the necessity for collaboration among all parties to effectively manage firecracker usage. Measures taken by the Delhi government include restrictions on older vehicles and staggered work hours.

item.title: US intelligence confirms image shows China's secret spaceplane in orbit
item.description: The US Defense Intelligence Agency has unveiled a detailed satellite image showcasing China's experimental reusable spaceplane currently in orbit. This vehicle exhibits design traits reminiscent of the US Space Force's X-37B, indicating active engagement in diverse orbital tasks. Following its recent fourth mission, apprehensions regarding its military function and potential have surged.

item.title: Von der Leyen proposes associate membership for Ottawa
item.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen's recent proposal for an associate membership with Canada seeks to bolster collaboration without full EU membership. This initiative dovetails with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's strategy to broaden trade relations with Europe. Together, both parties aim to fortify economic partnerships and jointly innovate in sectors like artificial intelligence and supercomputing, consequently navigating shared interests and global challenges.
